data.name: InfinityMine
data.detailed_description:
No enemies. Your only foes are the daily market and mounting debt.

"InfinityMine" is a mining economic roguelite where you are at the mercy of grueling labor and a ruthless market.

Your goal is simple.

"Mine, sell, and pay off your debt." But in this infinite underground world, getting greedy means losing everything.

Do you have enough stamina left? Is your backpack full? What are today's market prices? Every single decision means the difference between life, death, and profit.

Mine. Craft. Upgrade.

Experience the sheer satisfaction of smashing through a physics-driven voxel underworld that changes its shape every time you dive in. You start with nothing but a rusty pickaxe, but the money you earn will let you craft gear that changes everything.

Copper, iron, uranium, and diamonds. There are over 10 types of ores. However, selling isn't their only purpose; they are also crucial for crafting and upgrades. Making the wrong choice about what to sell now will only make you suffer later.

Stronger and deeper. With every gear upgrade, your mining speed accelerates, paving the way to the unknown depths.

  • Overwhelming Destruction: The tactile satisfaction of physically shattering the ground in your way.

  • Challenge the Depths: Upgrade your gear and reach depths no one has ever seen.

The Lethal Trap of "Just One More": Balancing Weight and Greed

Your backpack capacity is limited. A rare ore is right in front of you, but you are already close to your weight limit. "Do I drop this to pick up that?" Do you play it safe and bring back a massive haul of cheap rocks, or risk it all for a rare jackpot? This endless series of choices dictates your daily profit.

The market is a living beast. Don't miss your chance to sell.

The most terrifying enemy in this world is a "market crash." The ores you risked your life to mine could be worth less than scrap metal by tomorrow. Conversely, worthless rocks might suddenly skyrocket in price. You must check the market rates every single day. Sell high, keep it when it's low. That is your top priority for survival.

  • Debt Repayment: Deadlines wait for no one. Will you be forced to sell at a loss?

  • Warehouse Speculation: Will you hoard your ores in the warehouse, praying for a price surge?

Death Means Working for Free

There is no combat. But tension is your constant companion. Oxygen depletion, cave-ins. If your stamina runs out, all the ores you mined that day are lost. The greed of "just one more ore" will drive you to bankruptcy. The courage to turn back is your only defense.

Key Features

  • Non-Combat Pure Mining Roguelite: Absolutely no enemies. Your only focus is to mine, craft, and earn.

  • Dynamic Ore Economy: Daily fluctuating buying prices will dictate your strategy and fate. Read the market waves and maximize your profits.

  • The Tension of "Working for Free": If your stamina depletes, you lose all the ores you gathered that day. The greedier you get, the higher the risk of running out of time and losing your life. Your "courage to turn back" will be tested.

  • Tool Crafting for the Depths: Over 10 types of pickaxes and upgrade elements. Progression drastically changes your exploration range and efficiency.

  • Infinite Voxel World: More than 10 unique ores and mysterious ancient ruins await you.

Can you survive the economic struggle of this infinite mine, claim the title of a legendary miner, and win your freedom?

[/p]

Video Streaming & Let's Plays (Work Log Publication Authorized)

Broadcasting your mining operations (video streaming and Let's Plays) in InfinityMine is fully authorized for both individuals and corporations.

No prior application is required. Monetization through various video platform partner programs is fully permitted.
Earn as much as you can to help pay off your debts. However, there is one request.
Please include a link to this Steam store page in your video description.
Consider it a small request for cooperation to recruit new laborers to the underground.
(Note: Using game footage for content that violates public order and morals, or for malicious purposes, is strictly prohibited.)

data.short_description: No enemies—debt and a volatile ore market are your true foes. Mine a dungeon that changes every day. Drop to 0 HP and you lose the day’s mined ore. Upgrade tools, manage carry limits, time sales, and descend to the deepest layer.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 (4GB) / AMD Radeon R9 390 (4GB)
  • Storage: 25 GB GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD 推奨
